video.title: The Overhyped Fantasy Draft Values I’m Steering Clear Of

summary: Josh Lloyd goes through players he thinks are overvalued ("busts") for 9-category leagues, based on current Yahoo ranks and ADP, Fantrax ADP and ESPN ranks and ADP. His main targets are Tyrese Maxey at 6, Trae Young, Devin Booker, Chet Holmgren, Evan Mobley, Jalen Brunson, Donovan Clingan, Walker Kessler, Alex Sarr, Mikal Bridges, Miles Bridges and AJ Dybantsa. Many of his concerns come from roster changes that cut usage, such as stars returning, new teammates or more competition for touches. He also flags players whose big seasons were inflated by injuries to teammates. ESPN gets singled out for strange ranks, such as Mikal Bridges at 26, Bam Adebayo at 15 and Derrick White at 16. His general message is that reaching a little is fine if it fits your build, but these prices leave little room for profit.

rules.text: Rank and ADP are the only large-scale guides to what drafters do. How much they matter depends on your league: some leagues follow ranks closely, others follow ADP, and some go rogue.
rules.quote: In some leagues, rank will be very highly adhered to. In some leagues, people will really, really pay attention to ADP

rules.text: Reaching for a player to fill a category need is acceptable if it fits your build. You do not have to be rigid about value.
rules.quote: Like we don't have to be as strict and rigid as it sometimes feels like we are.

rules.text: Yahoo ADP mixes points and category drafts. Players valued in points leagues can show up high in category draft rooms and at the top of autodraft queues.
rules.quote: So if you or a league mate sorts the draft room by ADP, he'll come up at 56.

rules.text: Seasons put up while key teammates were injured are hard to repeat once those teammates return.
rules.quote: he played the majority of the season without either Embiid or Paul George and a chunk of the season

rules.text: Playing every game does not add value if the player's per-game production is unrosterable.
rules.quote: So I don't care that he plays every game. At some point he won't, by the way

rules.text: The consensus labels a player injury-prone or healthy after just one season. The speaker disagrees with this but says it affects market perception.
rules.quote: All it takes in in the in the bulk consensus idea for someone to stay healthy or to be injuryprone is one season.

rules.text: ADPs are not assigned by a person. They update every day from the drafts that actually happen, so do not wait for a site to 'fix' them.
rules.quote: The ADPs update every single day based on the data from drafts that happen. ADPs are not a number that someone just assigns.

rules.text: A points-only scorer needs a lot of usage to return value. Usage gets harder to find when there is competition for touches.
rules.quote: He'll be a points guy. And to get a lot of points, you need a lot of usage.

rules.text: Do not reach for centers out of fear of a shortage. It is better to find centers later than to take one about 60 spots too early.
rules.quote: I'd rather have no centers to pick from than someone take someone 60 spots too high and I can find some guys later
